name: Cosine annealing
tagline: Smoothly decays learning rate from base_lr to zero following a half-cosine over the full epoch budget.
diff_from_baseline: Loshchilov & Hutter, ICLR 2017 (SGDR). Standard cosine annealing without warmup or restarts; a default schedule for vision classifiers.

name: One-Cycle (Smith)
tagline: Cosine ramp from base_lr/25 up to base_lr in the first 30% of training, then cosine anneal back to base_lr/25.

key_hyperparams.name: pct_start
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of training spent ramping up

diff_from_baseline: Smith & Topin 2019 ('Super-Convergence'). Single warm-up + decay cycle that often enables larger peak learning rates and faster convergence.

name: Warmup + cosine
tagline: Linear warmup for 5 epochs from base_lr/5 to base_lr, then cosine anneal to zero over the remaining schedule.
diff_from_baseline: Goyal et al. 2017 ('Accurate, Large Minibatch SGD'). Linear warmup before cosine decay; common starting point for large-batch SGD training.
